About.title: About
About.body: Yacht Assist Montenegro exists to be the single most useful place to plan and run a yacht visit to Montenegro. Our starting point is a simple observation: the real competition isn't another directory — it's a captain Googling around and piecing together scattered Google Maps pins. We're building the info hub first: clearance and customs procedures, Montenegrin yacht laws, and a fuel price that's kept genuinely current, week to week. A directory of verified service providers — agents, provisioning, maintenance, transfers, chandlery, berths — comes next, free for yachters to browse and contact.
About.verificationNote: Content on this site is reviewed and updated by hand. If you spot something out of date or incorrect, please let us know via the contact page.
